links.outcome: Frequency of insulin dosing advice lacking a clear warning to account for insulin-on-board
links.effect: The potential safety failure occurred across all four LLMs tested through programmatic endpoints and both LLMs tested through chat interfaces. Specific rates are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: We found occurrences of the potential safety failure across four LLMs tested through programmatic endpoints and two LLMs tested through chat interfaces.

links.outcome: Change in safety failure rate when context about meal, insulin history and regimen varied
links.effect: Rates of the potential safety failure varied with the context given about the patient's meal and insulin history and treatment regimen. Numeric rates are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: The rates of the potential safety failure varied when different context was given about the patient's meal and insulin history and treatment regimen.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of LLM safety failures regarding insulin-on-board advice for pediatric type 1 diabetes, highlighting the need for guardrails but not testing a specific safeguard intervention.
